name: crisp-mcp
description: Crisp (messaging): me, list_inbound, get_thread, reply, mark_read. Every tool maps to a documented e

platform_mcp_crisp_identifier.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CRISP_IDENTIFIER
platform_mcp_crisp_identifier.description: Identifier half of the Crisp token keypair (plugin token from the Marketplace, or a website token), sent as the HTTP Basic username — 'Authorization: Basic BASE64(identifier:key)' (https://docs.crisp.chat/guides/rest-api/authentication/plugin-token/, https://docs.crisp.chat/guides/rest-api/authentication/website-token/).

platform_mcp_crisp_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CRISP_KEY
platform_mcp_crisp_key.description: Key half of the Crisp token keypair, sent as the HTTP Basic password ('--user "{identifier}:{key}"' in the official curl examples).

platform_mcp_crisp_website_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CRISP_WEBSITE_ID
platform_mcp_crisp_website_id.description: Crisp website (workspace) identifier that prefixes every route (/website/{website_id}/...). Env: PLATFORM_MCP_CRISP_WEBSITE_ID.

tools.name: me
tools.description: 'Resolves an existing website information' (the official curl example for both token types); account carries the envelope {error, reason, data{website_id, name, domain, logo}}.

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.description: 'Lists conversations for website' (scope website:conversation:sessions), one row per conversation: `id` = `thread_id` = session_id, `text` is 'Last message excerpt (from visitor)', `from` the visitor email (meta.email; nickname under raw.meta, unread counters under raw.unread). `page` is the page_number path segment; per_page must be 'between 20 and 50, defaults to 20' — the runtime caps `limit` at 50 but does not raise values below 20 (UNCONFIRMED how Crisp treats them). `since` is sent as filter_date_start ('date, ISO 8601, eg. 2018-03-01T17:00:00.000Z'); `channel` is not sent. updated_at / created_at are Unix ms under raw.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: 'Resolves messages in an existing conversation. Returns the last batch of messages if there are many messages in the conversation' (scope website:conversation:messages): there is no page-size parameter, so `limit` and `page` are ignored (older batches need timestamp_before, not sent) and `channel` is ignored. `thread_id` is the session_id; `id` is the numeric message fingerprint; `from` is the sending user id (user.user_id, 'may be operator user identifier or session identifier'; direction user/operator under raw.from); `text` is `content`, 'string if type is text or note, object if type is file, animation, audio, picker, field, carousel or event' — so non-text rows carry the content object; timestamp is Unix ms under raw.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: 'Sends a message in an existing conversation' as the operator (type text, from operator, origin chat; scope website:conversation:messages): `thread_id` is the session_id, `text` is `content` ('string if type is text'), `channel` is ignored. status is the envelope `reason`; message_id is data.fingerprint, the fingerprint Crisp assigns (UNCONFIRMED: the reference renders the response example dynamically, so the exact response body was not read).

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: 'Marks messages as read in conversation. Either using given message fingerprints, or all messages' (scope website:conversation:messages): with from=user and origin=chat this marks all visitor chat messages of the conversation as read ('fingerprints ... if not set, this marks all messages as read in conversation'). `thread_id` is the session_id and is required; `message_id` and `channel` are not sent (fingerprints is an array the flat body map cannot express). status is the envelope `reason`.
